verdict.rationale: Typesense lowers lock-in substantially: the full API surface is open source under GPL-3.0, it can be self-hosted free forever, and Typesense Cloud runs the same open-source engine, so users can move between Cloud and self-hosting. However, the pack never documents a way to export all data in an open format; the only format evidence (CSV/JSON) concerns pushing data into Typesense, not getting it out. missing for 10: documented bulk export of collections/documents in an open format (e.g. JSON/JSONL), documented Cloud-to-self-host migration path, independent corroboration of data portability.
